oracle.storm_kiln: {3}{R}; Magecraft — Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, create a Treasure token.
oracle.boltwave: {R}; Sorcery: Boltwave deals 3 damage to each opponent.
oracle.nalfeshnee: Whenever you cast a spell from exile, copy it; copied spells are not cast.
oracle.brain_freeze: {1}{U}; Instant; target player mills three cards; storm.

registered_cases.expected: A physically paid hand Boltwave from a real untapped Mountain triggers Storm-Kiln once (1 virtual Treasure) but not Nalfeshnee or The Lost and the Damned (not an exile/nonhand cast); opponent life loss occurs on resolution.

Physically paid {5}{R}{R}{R} Call from hand at X0 triggers Storm-Kiln once; first actual cascade-exiled Boltwave sorcery cast triggers Storm-Kiln a second time, then Nalfeshnee copies it and Storm-Kiln triggers a THIRD time; actual Boltwave and virtual copy each resolve, no extra Abaddon cascade, Lost only once.

With X9, three Call cascades physically cast Arcane Signet, Sol Ring and Boltwave; Nalfeshnee copies each, but only instant/sorcery Boltwave cast and copied trigger Storm-Kiln. Call itself also triggered Storm-Kiln: total THREE Treasures, 3 Lost Spawns, one actual Boltwave cast.

With physically sourced Breach hand-cast and LED from graveyard, escape-paid Brain Freeze instant has storm count 2 from actual Breach+LED casts. Its real cast triggers Storm-Kiln once and its two virtual storm copies trigger two more: three Magecraft Treasures, one real Brain Freeze cast, two virtual copies, physical 99 conserved.

After actual exile Boltwave cast, opponent counters original before Nalfeshnee triggered copy resolves. Storm-Kiln still triggers once on real cast and again on the later actual spell COPY event; copy resolves and deals 3 to each opponent, original does not; plus source hand Call gives one separate Treasure.

An actual Arcane Signet exile-cast and Nalfeshnee's permanent-spell copy do not trigger Storm-Kiln at all; physically paid hand Call sorcery generates one Storm-Kiln Treasure, Lost one Spawn, no cast from virtual permanent copy.

Prosper exiles and later plays an actual Swamp from exile on owner's main with normal land-drop access: one Prosper Treasure plus one Lost Spawn; NO Storm-Kiln Magecraft, no spell casts, original 99 cards conserved.

explicit_boundaries: The 81 prior test cases remain valid and were never comprehensive all-effect modeling.
Only seven bounded new cases cover copy-aware Magecraft. Conditional pre-existing engine permanents from same physical 99 are assumed, not game-state prevalence.
Virtual spells and Treasure/Spawn token count are not counted among physical 99; all real listed cards remain conserved.
Storm-Kiln Treasure triggers occur from instant/sorcery spell CAST and spell COPY. Nalfeshnee's copied PERMANENT spell is not instant/sorcery and does not trigger Magecraft.
No M6.6 or M6.7 certification, no I/J PASS, no M7 approval or changes to 62 canonical locked decks.
